description: arrow_clause_empty enumerates 0u32..1u32<<n_pos and panics at 32 positives. Red construct 32 distinct-arity arrows via logical conjunction/difference and ask subtype to one member; must terminate true without panic. Need width-independent exact algorithm with pruning, not larger fixed integer or cap/approximation. Test 32/64+, small exhaustive oracle. One fresh agent, one commit onto PR215.

comments.text: For public red, avoid a negative literally equal to a positive (DNF cancellation can bypass calculator). Build 32 same-result/distinct-arity positive constraints through repeated A \\ (any \\ B), then query subtype to unary int->atom; false at first semantic branch but current 1u32<<32 panics before branching. Direct private Conj with 32 positives and one nonidentical negative can pin calculator independently. Large TRUE cases need pruning so replacing u32 with an exponential iterator is not enough.

title: Remove fixed-width arrow subset enumeration limit
